values.title: Delete project
values.summary: Permanently delete a project and all its environments.
values.body:
DELETE

/v1/projects/{project_id}

Deletes the project, every environment, database and function. This can’t be undone. Only owners can delete projects.

### Authorizations

**Authorization string required**

Bearer token. Use a server key or a user access token: Bearer <token>.

### Path parameters

**project_id string required**

The project to delete.

### Errors

**401 unauthorized**

The token is missing, expired or revoked.

**403 forbidden**

The key doesn't have the scope needed for this endpoint.

**404 not_found**

No project exists with this ID in the environment.
